changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: REFDATA.PROMOTION_METRIC — metrics available for IS_BEST_IND auto-promote comparison

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Seed promotion metrics: HARD = threshold gate, SOFT = comparison. Priority controls eval order.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO REFDATA.PROMOTION_METRIC (NAME, DISPLAY_NAME, METRIC_KEY, DIRECTION, REQUIREMENT_TYPE, PRIORITY, THRESHOLD, DESCRIPTION, USER_ID, UPDATED_AT) VALUES ('sharpe_gate', 'Sharpe > 0', 'Sharpe Ratio', 'higher_is_better', 'HARD', 0, 0, 'Must have positive Sharpe to be promoted', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('max_dd_gate', 'Max DD <= 40%', 'Max Drawdown', 'lower_is_better', 'HARD', 10, 0.40, 'Drawdown must not exceed 40%', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('sharpe_compare', 'Sharpe Ratio', 'Sharpe Ratio', 'higher_is_better', 'SOFT', 0, NULL, 'Primary comparison metric', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('calmar_compare', 'Calmar Ratio', 'Calmar Ratio', 'higher_is_better', 'SOFT', 20, NULL, 'Secondary comparison metric', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('total_return', 'Total Return', 'Total Return', 'higher_is_better', 'SOFT', 40, NULL, 'Cumulative strategy return', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('annualized_return', 'Annualized Return', 'Annualized Return', 'higher_is_better', 'SOFT', 60, NULL, 'Compound annual growth rate', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ('max_drawdown', 'Max Drawdown', 'Max Drawdown', 'lower_is_better', 'SOFT', 80, NULL, 'Worst peak-to-trough decline (lower wins)', 'system', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Replace GT/LT symbols in DISPLAY_NAME to avoid XML issues
changeSet.sql: UPDATE REFDATA.PROMOTION_METRIC SET DISPLAY_NAME = 'Sharpe GT 0' WHERE NAME = 'sharpe_gate'; UPDATE REFDATA.PROMOTION_METRIC SET DISPLAY_NAME = 'Max DD LTE 40%' WHERE NAME = 'max_dd_gate';
